title: TritonParse Autotune Event
description: Raw record written by the AutotuneListener callback each time Triton's autotuner resolves a kernel, whether by benchmarking or from its own cache. This is the writer-side event; the parser consumes it and folds it into the autotune_analysis event's `autotune_result` member.

pid.description: Process ID that ran the autotuner.

stack.description: Call stack at the autotune callback.

kernel_name.description: Name of the autotuned kernel function.

best_config.description: String form of the winning triton.Config, e.g. "BLOCK_SIZE_M: 16, ..., num_warps: 1". Stringified by the writer because a Config is not JSON-serializable; it is also what keys configs_timings.

configs_timings.description: Measured timings keyed by the string form of each candidate config. Values are whatever the autotuner recorded -- currently a [min, mean, max] triple in milliseconds -- and are deliberately left unconstrained so a Triton-side change does not fail validation on a field nothing here interprets.

duration.description: Wall-clock seconds the autotuner spent resolving this kernel.

cache_hit.description: True when the autotuner answered from its cache instead of timing the candidates.

autotune_key.description: String form of the autotune key tuple -- the argument values the @triton.autotune key= list selects on.

StackFrame.description: A single frame in the call stack.

line.description: Line number in the source file.
